title: Emergency fund money for March 2026 storm damage
summary: An administration official said on October 20 that no more emergency fund requests are expected right now. In June, officials said they expect to return sometime in fiscal 27 with a budget amendment to cover the funding need. In April, the committee cut $32 million from the emergency fund, which showed about $117 million, after the budget director said storm recovery money may not be reimbursable.
